meterbox-mcp: unknown argument: --stdio

meterbox-mcp: connect a stdio MCP client to Meterbox.

Environment:
  METERBOX_AGENT_KEY   agent key from Settings > API keys (its prefix picks sandbox or production)
  METERBOX_BASE_URL    optional: your Meterbox host, for a self-hosted Meterbox
                       (default https://meterbox.ai)

Options:
  --toolsets a,b       only expose these toolsets (narrows what the key allows)
  --help               show this help

Clients that support remote servers can connect to https://meterbox.ai/mcp/<sandbox|production>
(or your own host's) directly instead.
